0022600117.text: The Detroit Pistons (1-0, 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East, on a one-game winning streak) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (2-0, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, on a two-game winning streak). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Pistons won 4-0 against the 76ers in 2025-26, most recently 116-93 in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026. The 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back, fracture), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps, strain).
